The terms of settlement are extracted hereunder :-
"1.

It is agreed between the parties that they can not continue the matrimonial life and agrees to dissolve their marriage by obtaining a decree of divorce by way of mutual consent/ court decree in the concerned family court.

It is further agreed that Ms. shall execute a GPA and other usual documents in faovur of Mr. Gautam Bhaskar in respect of a farm house at Sector-135, Village Dostpur, Mangroli, Khadar, Pargana,
Dadri Tehsil and Distt. Gautambudh Nagar, U.P. measuring 1786.5 sq.yds (Hec-0.1494).
It is further agreed that the photocopy of said GPA and other documents shall be filed along with first motion petition.
However, the original of the said documents shall remain in possession of Ms. .

It is further agreed that the said original GPA and other documents shall be handover be handover by Mr . Gautam Bhaskar at the time of recording of statement in second motion before the Ld. Court concerned.
2. It is agreed between the parties that both parties will cooperate with each other for taking divorce by mutual .consent, however, it is agreed that Ms Bhaskar shall not claim (present, past and future)/ permanent alimony as consented by her that she will not claim any consideration/ maintenance (present, past and future)/ permanent alimony etc. and /or dowry articles.
3. It is agreed between the parties that both parties shall filed petition for seeking divorce by way of mutual consent as first motion before the competent court of law,
in accordance with law within 15 days from today and both the parties shall cooperate with each other for preparation of the said petition.

Both the parties undertake to cooperate with each other in preparation, drafting, signing the petition and affidavit and providing relevant documents to the Advocate/s and also undertake to appear before the concerned Family Court for recording their statements for both motions in mutual divorce.

4. It is agreed between the parties that both the parties shall file petition seeking divorce by way of mutual consent as second motion, subject to seeking waiving of statutory period of six month by the order of Ld. Family Court, before the concerned family This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/12/2023 at 22:45:42 court in accordance with law.

5. It is agreed that the permanent custody of the children namely Khushi Bhaskar and master Rudra Bhaskar shall remain with their mother/ defendant Ms. and the plaintiff Mr. Gautam Bhaskar shall not claim custody or visitation rights towards the children in future.
